company_blurb: Nordlys Systems builds cloud infrastructure management tools for enterprise clients across Northern Europe. Headquartered in Helsinki, the company values steady engineering, clear documentation, and a balanced work week.

departments.culture: Engineering prioritizes system stability, peer code reviews, and uninterrupted focus blocks. Discussions happen mostly in async threads, and release schedules are planned well in advance to avoid late nights.

Finance operates on predictable monthly cycles, clean spreadsheets, and cross-departmental check-ins. The team values accuracy over speed and shares an appreciation for quiet afternoons and good coffee.
Legal maintains a calm, structured environment focused on clear contract language and regulatory compliance. Documentation is rigorously versioned, and requests are handled through a steady queue.
Sales balances active client outreach with collaborative pipeline reviews. Rather than high-pressure tactics, the team emphasizes thorough product demos, steady follow-ups, and accurate forecasting.

Olli Korhonen builds revenue models and tracks quarterly metrics in Finance. Outside of spreadsheets, he enjoys roasting coffee beans and organizing the office board game nights.
Kaisa Virtanen coordinates regional enterprise accounts as a sales manager. She focuses on long-term client relationships and keeps team meetings brisk and structured.
Ville Koskinen oversees regulatory standards and vendor reviews in Legal. He writes thorough memos and appreciates well-indexed shared drives.
Markus Laitinen manages monthly reconciliations and expense reporting in Finance. Known for his calm demeanor, he rarely misses a deadline or an afternoon coffee break.
Sanna Nieminen analyzes departmental budgets and cost forecasts in Finance. She is quick to help teammates troubleshoot complex formulas and enjoys cross-country skiing.
Noora Lehtonen leads platform reliability projects in Engineering. She advocates for automated testing, clean code reviews, and direct feedback during sprint planning.
Kalle Hamalainen drafts contract templates and maintains filing systems as a paralegal in Legal. He is methodical, punctual, and enjoys historical nonfiction.
Sanna Koskinen manages mid-market client renewals and demos in Sales. She brings steady energy to client calls and always remembers colleagues' birthdays.
Antti Rantanen maintains core database services as a senior engineer. He communicates in short, precise updates and spends weekends restoring vintage audio gear.
Venla Koskinen handles outbound enterprise prospecting and client onboarding in Sales. She keeps a positive outlook during busy quarters and organizes group lunches.
Sanna Lehtonen supports contract redlining and archive organization in Legal. She has a subtle sense of humor about paperwork and keeps an immaculate desk.
